newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Toyota South Africa earnings seen higher.
newsitem.headline: Toyota South Africa earnings seen higher.

text.p: Toyota South Africa Ltd should post higher earnings for the year to December 31, 1996, analysts said on Thursday.

"There may be a surprise in the result...Toyota is doing quite well with sales. It is a strong player. Sales (overall) may go down for 1997/98 but Toyota is doing better than the market," an industry analyst who declined to be identified said.

Analysts polled by Reuters forecast earnings per share rising to between 490 and 530 cents with consensus at 515 cents -- an improvement of 7.92 percent from 477.2 reported for the year ending December 31, 1995.
They expected a dividend range of 83 to 90 cents, with consensus at 86.6 cents compared with the previous year's 80 cents, equal to an increase of 8.25 percent.
Toyota was top seller in South Africa in January with 6,483 vehicles. Volkswagen was second with sales of 5,462.
